resources.string: Collecting from your start date. Earned medals are permanent.
OFF · Start your own achievement journey when you are ready.
Paused · Your medals and progress are preserved.

Count verified activity from now on. Previously auto-awarded medals are archived and excluded from this new collection. XP, levels, tiers and usage records stay intact. Earned medals will never reset. The first token observation establishes a baseline.
Keep all earned medals and progress. Resume counting new verified activity from now; activity while paused will not be awarded retroactively.
